Hymn 148: Sabbath Day
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Ebenezer Beesley
Lyricist/Text Author: Paul L. Anderson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 148 titled "Sabbath Day" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by Paul L. Anderson.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
